headline: Oil and yields plunged on US-Iran settlement hopes and a Democratic sweep of Congress, with the October jobs report Friday setting up December Fed hike odds.
rates: The 10-year yield fell to about 4.88% (near a two-month low) and the 2-year to about 4.55% as oil dropped and the dollar weakened.
fed: CME FedWatch put a December hike at roughly 80%; the next FOMC is Dec 8-9, and the Friday payrolls print will heavily shape those odds.
oil: Brent fell about 8.7% to roughly $94.6 and WTI to about $88 on bets that Washington and Tehran are near a settlement, though the Hormuz supply threat is not resolved.
geo: US-Iran talks via Qatar continue with no binding deal, and Democrats won both the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms.
